projects.title: semgrepll
projects.description: A local semantic code-search CLI for AI coding agents. Indexes code by meaning, runs embeddings locally through llama.cpp, ONNX Runtime, or Ollama, and stores vectors in SQLite or LanceDB.

projects.title: Lazy Matcher
projects.description: An asynchronous job-matching pipeline that extracts job descriptions from text or URLs, scores them against a candidate profile, and processes work through PostgreSQL-backed workers with Redis queueing, LLM scoring, and deterministic fallback.

projects.title: WikWok
projects.description: A mobile-first Wikipedia discovery app with a swipeable feed, search, trending topics, 10+ languages, and an installable PWA.
